correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, the code of even-index adjacent pairs (2j,2j+1) plus long-gap pairs (4j+1,4j+4) has floor(n/2)+floor((n-1)/4) distinct words. Their weight-one deletion descendants and distinct weight-two descendants cannot overlap across blocks. For the upper bound take all n-1 weight-one outputs and ceil((n-1)/2) chosen adjacent weight-two outputs covering each adjacent input; every input has >=2 distinct selected outputs. Disjoint descendants force 2|C|<=n-1+ceil((n-1)/2), whose integer floor equals floor((3n-2)/4). Independently checked construction and transversal via raw strings for n=3..55; unrestricted theorem follows from the symbolic argument.
